result.instructions: Tools for everbill, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Create a bill for the completed job for customer Example GmbH and send it by email."; "Show me the latest bills and tell me which ones are still open."; "Find the customer with the email address anna@example.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes everbill data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run everbill_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run everbill_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run everbill_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. everbill_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: everbill_check_connection
tools.title: Check connection
tools.description: Check that the everbill API key still works. Exchanges the key for an access token and calls GET /check_token. Returns the vendor's reply.

tools.name: everbill_list_bills
tools.title: List bills
tools.description: List the bills (invoices) of the account. Each item has the bill data (status, number, date, customer). The spec documents no filters or pages, so the list can be large; use limit. GET /bills/index.

limit.description: Return at most this many items (client-side trim).

tools.name: everbill_get_bill
tools.title: Get a bill
tools.description: Get one bill by its id with its customer, address, articles (line items) and transactions (payments). GET /bills/view/{id}.

tools.name: everbill_get_bill_pdf
tools.title: Get a bill PDF
tools.description: Download the PDF of a bill by its document number. Returns { number, filename, byteLength, pdfBase64 }. GET /bills/get_pdf/{number}.

number.description: Document number, for example from everbill_list_bills.

tools.name: everbill_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customers of the account. The spec documents no filters or pages; use limit. GET /customers/index.

limit.description: Return at most this many items (client-side trim).

tools.name: everbill_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id with its contact person and tags. GET /customers/view/{id}.

tools.name: everbill_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Find customers whose one field equals a value. `field` is an everbill customer field name (the spec does not list them; test a known value first). POST /customers/search_by_field.

field.description: Customer field name to match, for example email.

tools.name: everbill_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Only `name` is required. Creates a new customer record each time it is called (no duplicate check). POST /customers/add.

uid.description: VAT or company id (sent as UID).

tools.name: everbill_create_bill
tools.title: Create a bill
tools.description: Create a bill (invoice) with its line items. Default status ZUVS (to send). Each call creates a new bill. For an existing customer, pass customer.id from everbill_list_customers or everbill_get_customer. POST /bills/add.

id.description: Existing customer id, if the customer already exists.

uid.description: VAT or company id (sent as UID).

customer.description: The customer the bill is for.

price.description: Unit price, net or gross as set by brutto (required).

ust.description: VAT rate in percent, for example 20.

unit.description: Unit, for example Stk or h.

status.description: Bill status code. Default ZUVS (to send).

ust.description: VAT mode: 0 calculate VAT (default), 1 no VAT, 2 EU invoice, 3 foreign, 4 reverse charge.

brutto.description: true for a gross bill, false (default) for a net bill.

tools.name: everbill_send_bill_email
tools.title: Send a bill by email
tools.description: Send a bill PDF by email to its customer, from sender_mail / sender_name. This sends a real email to a real customer. user_id defaults to the account user id. POST /bills/send_mail/{number}.

number.description: Document number, for example from everbill_list_bills.

user_id.description: everbill user id. Default: the account user id of the API key.

filename.description: PDF file name in the email.

tools.name: everbill_list_articles
tools.title: List articles
tools.description: List the articles (products and services) of the account. The spec documents no filters or pages; use limit. GET /articles/index.

limit.description: Return at most this many items (client-side trim).

tools.name: everbill_get_article
tools.title: Get an article
tools.description: Get one article by id, with its prices, VAT and stock fields. GET /articles/view/{id}.

tools.name: everbill_create_article
tools.title: Create an article
tools.description: Create an article (product or service) with its name, unit and net price. Each call creates a new article. POST /articles/add.

unit.description: Unit, for example Stk or h.

ust.description: VAT rate in percent, for example 20.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with everbill
prompts.description: What you can do with everbill here, with example requests to try.
